title: Concept: Transitive graph cannot be bounded per dependency
description: pom.xml declares a dependency entry with no `<exclusions>`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency entry with no `<exclusions>`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency entry with no `<exclusions>`.
